clips.title: The story
paras: Arnak's Hoof is the macabre proof of death taken from the criminal Arnak Grimtotem. Hunted down on the bluffs of Darkcloud Pinnacle, Arnak was marked for execution by the defenders of Freewind Post after murdering a fellow tauren and kidnapping his sister.

Arnak Grimtotem earned notoriety throughout Thousand Needles as an outlaw whose brutality crossed even the contentious lines of tauren clan politics. After murdering another tauren and abducting the victim's sister, Lakota Windsong, a formal bounty was posted for his death. Arnak holed up on the heights of Darkcloud Pinnacle, surrounded by Grimtotem guards. Slaying him and claiming his severed hoof serves as undeniable confirmation for Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post that the murderer has finally answered for his crimes.
